text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In preparation for the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
we decided to hold an open practice 
session for the press.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: With that, the public training session is—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Biwa Hayahide! Could we request 
an additional solo interview with you?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin-san is running in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring) too, right!? As one of the 
BNW...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steadily producing results, Biwa Hayahide 
had gratefully become one of the Umamusume 
garnering massive attention from the 
public.

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide-san! Biwa Hayahide-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, as expected, we couldn't 
accept all the interview requests. I bowed 
apologetically to the reporters who came 
that day and sent them home."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, Trainer-kun. I really didn't 
mind, you know.
choice_data_list: Still, I want you to focus.

But it's because I want you to stay 
focused

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you up on that, then. Would you 
be willing to give me some of your time 
this coming weekend?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I have some important business to 
take care of. Important to both of us, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And on the promised day, the place Biwa 
Hayahide called me out to was—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
We've been blessed with perfect weather 
here at Nakayama Racecourse today.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The fan favorite for the Satsuki Sho is 
this girl right here, Narita Brian!!"
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What terrifying popularity. I suppose all 
of this is what makes "Narita Brian."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian holds a good position. Coming 
around the first corner, the trailing pack 
is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to the excited spectators, 
Biwa Hayahide watched quietly.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The race proceeds at a slightly fast pace. 
800 meters remaining! How will this tempo 
affect the runners?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's a fast pace, but there's no gap 
between the leader and the front 
pack—they're virtually running as one 
solid group.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A contest down the homestretch after 
burning through their stamina. Will it 
come down to a duel down to the wire—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian! Narita Brian breaks away!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Narita Brian! Three 
lengths, four lengths ahead of the pack. 
She keeps extending her lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an overwhelming victory! And in 
record-setting time!! Narita Brian is a 
force of nature—claiming her very first 
crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian. To think she'd win while 
setting an unexpected course record...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's the indisputable fact that she is 
'faster' than any Umamusume who has ever 
run 2000 meters at this Nakayama 
Racecourse."

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
That late kick she showed at the end was 
on another level entirely. To think an 
Umamusume like this would appear...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —I will defeat her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...If she could see this race before the 
Kikuka Sho, I wonder what she'd say."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only thing that can be said for sure 
is that her fighting spirit is burning 
hotter than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Looks like you have a call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Biwa Hayahide, I check my 
smartphone. The name displayed on the 
screen was...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So this year's Tenno Sho 
(Spring) will be held at Hanshin 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to renovations at Kyoto Racecourse, 
the venue for the Spring Tenno Sho has 
apparently been changed to Hanshin 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, that was—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Both Kyoto and Hanshin are 
clockwise tracks, but their slopes are 
vastly different. While Kyoto is flat 
before the goal, Hanshin has a fairly 
steep hill.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Unavoidable though it may be, our data so 
far and our planned strategy... won't 
work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...This will drastically overturn the 
theories we've built up with Biwa Hayahide 
leading up to the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then let us reconstruct the winning 
formula once more.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What is it, Trainer-kun? Aren't we 
proving it with actual results?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No matter how little time we have left, 
all we can do is give it our all toward 
victory and deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Just like back during the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...We're rebuilding practically from 
scratch, you know? It will definitely take 
up your free time as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The girl who was once lost was no 
longer there."
choice_data_list:
You've grown a whole lot more, haven't 
you?

You've grown a whole lot more, haven't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...? Trainer-kun, why are you staring at 
my face—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
M-My head hasn't gotten big, okay!? It's 
totally normal size!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what situation she faced, her 
resolve no longer wavered. She had 
undeniably grown.
